title: Multi-Site health summary truncation transparency
opportunity: The bounded health summary endpoint reported the returned row count as totalSites, so installations with more than 100 sites received an incomplete summary without an explicit boundary.
implementation: Preserved the complete stored-site count and returned-site count in the summary API.
Added a truncated flag when the bounded result does not include every stored site.
Added client DTO fields for returnedSites and truncated.
Displayed an operator-facing Thai warning in Browser and Desktop surfaces when the summary is bounded.

verification.impeccableDetector: 0 anti-patterns; four pre-existing advisory design-system color findings

boundary: Live PostgreSQL serialization with more than 100 sites
CodeQL/SARIF, external penetration testing, load/SLO, SIEM, Authenticode signing, and production certification
